name: GenSocialLookup
headline: GenSocialLookup: Username Search Across 420+
short_description: GenSocialLookup searches 420+ social media platforms to find usernames and track a user's social media footprint. Designed for OSINT professionals, cybersecurity experts, and researchers.
author: geniuszly

sections.overview:
GenSocialLookup is a username search tool that scans over 420 social media platforms to identify where a user maintains an online presence. It outputs results to a text file with color-coded terminal display for easy reading, includes connection error handling, and provides search performance statistics. The tool is built for OSINT (Open Source Intelligence) investigations, cybersecurity professionals conducting user research, and anyone needing to map a person's social media footprint across multiple platforms efficiently.
OSINT investigations and open source intelligence gathering
Cybersecurity threat research and user account discovery
Social media presence mapping for individuals or accounts
Digital footprint analysis and verification
sections.setup:
No install command available. Check the GitHub repository for manual installation instructions.
`git clone https://github.com/geniuszly/GenSocialLookup`
sections.usage:
```
Find the social media profiles for [COMPANY] in the [INDUSTRY] sector. Look for accounts on LinkedIn, Twitter, Facebook, Instagram, and TikTok. Provide the usernames and links if available. If you can't find a profile, note that as well.
```
